articles.title: Visa Announces Global Expansion of Agentic Ready Program
articles.mainIdea: Visa Announces Global Expansion of Agentic Ready Program
articles.summary: Business Wire: Visa Announces Global Expansion of Agentic Ready Program. SAN FRANCISCO, April 29, 2026--Visa Inc. (NYSE: V) today announced the expansion of its global Agentic Ready program to clients in Asia Pacific and Latin America. First launched with banks and issuing partners across Europe, including the UK, Agentic Ready is designed to support the payments ecosystem as it prepares for the emergence of agent-led commerce.
